inputs.text: [excited] TROH… oh… don. In Greek, the first part means "to wound," [serious] and "odon" is tooth. [curious] So what does that give us?
[happily] There you go. [proud] It lived in North America, seventy-five million years ago.
[curious] What was special about this one?
[proud] One huge thing: [amazed] it might be the smartest dinosaur we know of.
